display.title: {"text": "Underground Dungeons"}
description: Spawner rooms, mineshafts, crypts and strongholds. Dark, cramped, spawner-driven.
&ePrepare:&r Iron armour, torches, a shield. Strongholds: diamond gear.
&eSignature rewards:&r Shards in volume, the first Ancient Cores, spawners for Apothic Spawners.
&eComing back:&r Spawners can be kept and modified (Apothic Spawners). Mineshafts are huge but low value per chest.
&eFeeds into:&r Spawners -> mob farms (bounded by spawner count), cores -> sockets.
&eBrings home:&r Workshop discovery; the Hollow Roads expedition for the Expedition Hall. Iron and tools feed the press line.
&aDo:&r Walk into any underground dungeons structure (early-mid game).
&6You get:&r Shards in volume, the first Ancient Cores, spawners for Apothic Spawners.
